response: There is no established causative link between cerebromediastinal tuberculosis and Say-Barber-Miller syndrome. Say-Barber-Miller syndrome is a rare genetic disorder characterized by X-linked mental retardation, while cerebromediastinal tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The co-occurrence of these two conditions in a child may be coincidental, and further research is needed to determine if there is any potential association or underlying vulnerability.
